source: Confirmed on Scale firmware 2.0.2-RC1 with tools/ble_probe.py on 2026-10-20 (doc/ble-probe/ble-2.0.2-RC1.json): service 4fafc201-1fb5-459e-8fcc-c5c9c331914b with one characteristic for write and notify (read, write, notify), MTU 515, continuous measurement over BLE acknowledged. Production 2.0.1 speaks the same protocol but was not probed.
